key_insight: KampoBench shifts LLM evaluation in Kampo medicine from recall-based exam questions to consultation-style judgment on patient-specific scenarios.
clinical_relevance: For clinical NLP, this benchmark better tests whether models can give context-aware traditional medicine guidance rather than only answer factual questions.
method: 310 conversation-specific rubric criteria adapted from HealthBench
10 current models from 3 vendors; each answer graded by models from all three vendors plus physician-revised references
evidence_signal: The best model scored 74.8-86.3% across graders, while physician-revised reference answers scored 87.9-92.4%, with stable grader rankings (Spearman's rho 0.952-0.976).
watch_item: Grader leniency still varied by 14.3 points, so scores may depend on which grader is used even when family bias is small.
paper_title: From examinations to consultations: a physician-reviewed Japanese benchmark for large language models in traditional Kampo medicine
